steps.code:
# Search for each song and add the exact match to the playlist
playlist_id = create_result['playlist_id']
added_count = 0

for line in song_lines:
    # Parse "Title by Artist" or "Title by Artist1, Artist2"
    parts = line.split(' by ')
    title = parts[0]
    artists_str = parts[1]
    
    # Search for the song
    search_result = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=f"{title} {artists_str}", access_token=spotify_token)
    
    # Find the exact match (title and all artists match)
    exact_match = None
    for song in search_result:
        if song['title'].lower() == title.lower():
            # Check if all artists in the note are in the song's artists
            note_artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
            song_artists = [a['name'].lower() for a in song['artists']]
            if all(any(na.lower() == sa for sa in song_artists) for na in note_artists):
                exact_match = song
                break
    
    if exact_match:
        add_result = apis.spotify.add_song_to_playlist(
            playlist_id=playlist_id,
            song_id=exact_match['song_id'],
            access_token=spotify_token
        )
        print(f"Added: {title} (song_id={exact_match['song_id']}) -> {add_result}")
        added_count += 1
    else:
        print(f"NOT FOUND: {line}")

print(f"\nTotal added: {added_count}")
